title: LSTM 循環時序網路
summary: 以閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度解析LSTM 循環時序網路：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore LSTM recurrent sequence network through gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在LSTM 循環時序網路案例中比較input與hidden state與input forget output gates，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate input/hidden states and input/forget/output gates within the LSTM recurrent sequence network case.

steps.title: 記憶與三個閘：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Memory and three gates: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對input與hidden state提出可反駁的記憶與三個閘模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable memory and three gates model and evidence record for input/hidden states.
steps.instruction: 在「LSTM 循環時序網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識input與hidden state。常見LSTM分開input、forget、output閘與候選更新；cell state和hidden state不是同一變數。 建立記憶與三個閘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在一個假想時間步重算門值、cell與hidden，核對shape。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify input/hidden states in the mentor diagram and primary sources for LSTM recurrent sequence network. Common LSTMs separate input/forget/output gates and candidate updates; cell and hidden state differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of memory and three gates, focusing on gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate gates, cell and hidden on one assumed step and check shapes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在一個假想時間步重算門值、cell與hidden，核對shape。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate gates, cell and hidden on one assumed step and check shapes.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：cell state與hidden state可在所有公式中互換。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Cell and hidden states are interchangeable in every equation.
steps.check: 提交input與hidden state的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for input/hidden states.

knowledge.title: 記憶與三個閘
knowledge.text: 常見LSTM分開input、forget、output閘與候選更新；cell state和hidden state不是同一變數。 本課架構對應：input與hidden state
knowledge.textEn: Common LSTMs separate input/forget/output gates and candidate updates; cell and hidden state differ. Course architecture correspondence: Input/hidden states

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 在一個假想時間步重算門值、cell與hidden，核對shape。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；cell state與hidden state可在所有公式中互換。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate gates, cell and hidden on one assumed step and check shapes. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Cell and hidden states are interchangeable in every equation.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設帶bias的標準四組LSTM矩陣，輸入d=6、hidden h=10，參數=4h(d+h+1)=680。若簡化記憶路徑forget固定0.95且忽略其他項，20步導數因子0.95²⁰≈0.358486；不是完整LSTM梯度或產品表現。
knowledge.textEn: Assume four standard biased LSTM matrices with input d=6 and hidden h=10: 4h(d+h+1)=680 parameters. On a simplified memory path with fixed forget=0.95 and other terms omitted, a 20-step derivative factor is 0.358486, not the full LSTM gradient/performance.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「LSTM 循環時序網路」的「記憶與三個閘：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Memory and three gates: architecture analysis” in “LSTM recurrent sequence network”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for memory and three gates in input/hidden states?
options: 常見LSTM分開input、forget、output閘與候選更新；cell state和hidden state不是同一變數。
cell state與hidden state可在所有公式中互換。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Common LSTMs separate input/forget/output gates and candidate updates; cell and hidden state differ.
Cell and hidden states are interchangeable in every equation.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 常見LSTM分開input、forget、output閘與候選更新；cell state和hidden state不是同一變數。 在一個假想時間步重算門值、cell與hidden，核對shape。
quiz.explanationEn: Common LSTMs separate input/forget/output gates and candidate updates; cell and hidden state differ. Recalculate gates, cell and hidden on one assumed step and check shapes.

steps.title: 記憶與三個閘：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Memory and three gates: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對input與hidden state提出可反駁的記憶與三個閘模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable memory and three gates model and evidence record for input/hidden states.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「記憶與三個閘」模型，檢查input與hidden state的兩個假想案例。在一個假想時間步重算門值、cell與hidden，核對shape。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分常見LSTM分開input、forget、output閘與候選更新；cell state和hidden state不是同一變數。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous memory and three gates model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving input/hidden states. Recalculate gates, cell and hidden on one assumed step and check shapes. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Common LSTMs separate input/forget/output gates and candidate updates; cell and hidden state differ." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Recalculate gates, cell and hidden on one assumed step and check shapes.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：cell state與hidden state可在所有公式中互換。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Cell and hidden states are interchangeable in every equation.
steps.check: 提交input與hidden state的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for input/hidden states.

steps.title: 忘記閘與梯度路徑：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Forget gates and gradient paths: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對input forget output gates提出可反駁的忘記閘與梯度路徑模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable forget gates and gradient paths model and evidence record for input/forget/output gates.
steps.instruction: 在「LSTM 循環時序網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識input forget output gates。簡化記憶路徑導數含忘記閘乘積；完整梯度還有其他相依路徑。 建立忘記閘與梯度路徑的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定forget的簡式與有限差分完整小模型。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify input/forget/output gates in the mentor diagram and primary sources for LSTM recurrent sequence network. A simplified memory-path derivative contains products of forget gates; full gradients have other dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of forget gates and gradient paths, focusing on gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare fixed-forget simplification with full small-model finite differences. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較固定forget的簡式與有限差分完整小模型。
steps.observationEn: Compare fixed-forget simplification with full small-model finite differences.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：固定forget乘積就是完整LSTM總梯度。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A fixed-forget product is the full LSTM gradient.
steps.check: 提交input forget output gates的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for input/forget/output gates.

knowledge.title: 忘記閘與梯度路徑
knowledge.text: 簡化記憶路徑導數含忘記閘乘積；完整梯度還有其他相依路徑。 本課架構對應：input forget output gates
knowledge.textEn: A simplified memory-path derivative contains products of forget gates; full gradients have other dependencies. Course architecture correspondence: Input/forget/output gates

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較固定forget的簡式與有限差分完整小模型。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；固定forget乘積就是完整LSTM總梯度。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare fixed-forget simplification with full small-model finite differences. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: A fixed-forget product is the full LSTM gradient.

quiz.question: 就input forget output gates的「忘記閘與梯度路徑」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for forget gates and gradient paths in input/forget/output gates?
options: 固定forget乘積就是完整LSTM總梯度。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
簡化記憶路徑導數含忘記閘乘積；完整梯度還有其他相依路徑。
optionsEn: A fixed-forget product is the full LSTM gradient.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
A simplified memory-path derivative contains products of forget gates; full gradients have other dependencies.
quiz.explanation: 簡化記憶路徑導數含忘記閘乘積；完整梯度還有其他相依路徑。 比較固定forget的簡式與有限差分完整小模型。
quiz.explanationEn: A simplified memory-path derivative contains products of forget gates; full gradients have other dependencies. Compare fixed-forget simplification with full small-model finite differences.
